subject: Human Evolution
title: Svante Pääbo's Revolution
description: Learn Svante Pääbo's Revolution in one minute.

hook.text: In 2022, Svante Pääbo won the Nobel Prize for extracting and sequencing DNA from ancient bones.

buildup.text: For decades, scientists thought ancient DNA was too degraded to recover. Pääbo proved them wrong.

discovery.text: His team developed methods to read fragmented, contaminated DNA from fossils tens of thousands of years old.

twist.text: Without his work, we wouldn't know about interbreeding, Denisovans, or the Neanderthal genome at all.

climax.text: Paleogenomics—the field Pääbo created—has rewritten everything we thought about human origins.

punchline.text: One scientist turned dead bones into living data.

quiz.question: What did Svante Pääbo win the Nobel Prize for?
options: Developing methods to sequence ancient DNA from old bones
